assessment_summary.project_name: Elbow Duct with Turning Vanes CFD
assessment_summary.cou_name: Steady RANS to estimate pressure loss and flow quality for 90° square HVAC elbow for early sizing (AHU-7)

evidence_keywords: Mesh refinement study
K_coarse = 0.37
p_obs ≈ 1.92 for K
Extrapolated K_ext ≈ 0.345
estimated discretization band on fine grid ≈ 1.2% relative
Residuals: continuity and momentum below 1e-5
mass imbalance across inlet/outlet
Mass residuals balanced to within 0.05% at convergence
K variation <0.15% over the final 700 iterations
k-omega SST with low-Re wall treatment
Appropriateness of physics
This is a simplification but captures first-order roughness drag
Boundary and initial conditions
inlet turbulence intensity 5% (baseline)
Surface roughness modeled via ks = 0.1 mm
sensitivity explored 2% and 10%
doubling ks to 0.2 mm increased K by 2.1%
Laboratory Benchmark
Two static pressure rings installed at the tap planes
2D PIV (double-pulsed Nd:YAG, 200 mJ/pulse)
three cross sections (upstream plane, elbow mid-plane, downstream plane)
Environment stabilized at 20 ± 1 °C
air properties and bulk velocity were matched to within 0.5% of the test conditions
downstream tap plane in the model was positioned to coincide with the ring centerline
Matching simulation to test
CFD velocity data sampled on planes corresponding to PIV sheets
downsampled to PIV interrogation grid spacing
Measured K at 1.8 m3/s: 0.358 ± 0.007
CFD fine grid K at 1.8 m3/s: 0.349 ± 0.004
Difference: −2.6% relative to measurement mean
Spatial correlation coefficient between CFD and PIV velocity magnitude on the downstream plane: 0.94
